name: The Sportsman

menus.name: Full Menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner on every day it opens; one dish chosen from each of starter, fish, meat and pudding; cheese £5 extra

menus.name: Short Menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner, Tuesday to Thursday only; a starter, a fish or meat course and a pudding

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable, or by phone or email. Weekends book up six to eight months ahead, especially in summer; midweek tables usually need one or two months' notice. Dates not shown online may still be available by phone or email.
cancellation: Bookings can be changed on OpenTable up to 24 hours ahead. Cancellations within 24 hours and no-shows may be charged £25 per person. Parties of four or more give card details to secure the table (nothing is taken), within 8 hours or the booking lapses.
walkIns: Inside seats are kept for diners with bookings; there are some seats for drinkers in the conservatory.
waitlist: If no table is free, ask to be put on the waiting list by phone or email; cancellations do come up.
children: No children under 10, and no children's menu.

stay.fromNote: a cabin for two, £150 for later nights
stay.note: Five self-catering garden cabins with a light breakfast left in; book by phone or email.
